jobs_results.title: Data Analyst II, Tech
jobs_results.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically adept Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Engineering and Sharing Solutions Team, specializing in Ethics Compliance & Security data. In this high-impact role, you will be the technical bridge between complex data ecosystems and global regulatory requirements. You will assist in architecting data-sharing solutions and defining the rigorous SQL logic and Data Quality (DQ) frameworks that ensure our safety data is accurate, compliant, and audit-ready. To succeed, you must balance deep-dive technical work with the ability to consult cross-functionally, translating ambiguous legal needs into scalable analytical products.

What the Candidate Will Do

Define Reporting Logic: Develop and refine the core SQL transformations and business logic that serve as the "single source of truth" for all compliance and safety datasets.Define Data Quality (DQ) Standards: Establish and implement automated DQ frameworks and validation scripts to ensure data integrity before it reaches external regulators.Assist in Solution Architecture: Collaborate on the design of data-sharing frameworks that allow Operations teams to fulfill law enforcement and regulatory requests at scale.Technical Consultation: Serve as the primary analytical point of contact for Legal and Public Policy teams, translating complex regulatory requirements into precise technical specifications.Drive Scalability: Identify patterns in recurring data requests and build the technical documentation and modular workflows required to automate fulfillment.

What the Candidate Will Need

4+ years of experience in data analytics, with a focus on logic building and data modeling. B.Tech/B.E. or equivalent degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Computer Science, etc.) and background in Compliance, Risk, or Public Safety within FinTech, InsurTech, or a similar high-stakes environment.Advanced SQL Mastery: Expert-level ability to query multi-layered databases (CTEs, Window Functions) and build optimized data transformations.Data Quality Expertise: Proven track record of defining validation rules, exception reporting, and audit-ready datasets.Analytical Solution Design: Experience designing "self-service" data products or modular logic that enables other teams to execute with autonomy.Privacy Mindset: Deep understanding of data privacy (PII handling) and the technical nuances of data redaction. Ready to Ride?

 This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

 You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. jobs_results.title: Data Analyst, Risk
jobs_results.description:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.


Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree in a quantitative discipline.
2 years of experience or familiarity with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.
2 years of experience or familiarity with machine learning systems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
About the job
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety. At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.
Responsibilities
Analyze and solve complex problems using data and statistical methods.
Identify and prevent fraud and abuse.
Improve tools and automated systems through data analysis, technical expertise, and present to stakeholders.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs_results.title: Professional - Data Product Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation



At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.



Join us as we create something extraordinary together.




Job Overview:


LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.


This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.


The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.




Responsibilities:


Product Discovery & Capability Support


Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.


Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.


Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).


Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving


Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.


Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.


Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.


Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.


Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)


Support Data Product Owners by helping define:


Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions


Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls


Usage expectations and downstream dependencies


Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.


Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.


Agile Execution & Delivery


Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.


Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.


Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.


Stakeholder Communication & Influence


Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.


Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.


Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.




What are we looking for?


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.




Requirements:


4+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.


Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)


Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.


Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis


Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.


Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.


Solid understanding of:


Data modeling and semantic consistency


Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts


Pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)




Preferences:


Experience supporting advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.


Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.



Core Competencies:


Familiarity with downstream consumer needs (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).


Experience performing impact analysis for data changes across multiple consuming systems.


LPL Global Business Services, LLP - PRIVACY POLICY

jobs_results.title: Hiring Senior Data Analyst (Secunderabad)
jobs_results.description:
Data Analyst  

About the Role  
We are looking for a Data Analyst with robust SQL, dashboarding, and business analysis skills to transform business questions into clear, actionable analytical outputs.  
The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across business and technical teams, translating requirements into structured analysis, building dashboards and reports, and maintaining clear documentation around business metrics, definitions, and data logic.  
Key Responsibilities  
- Analyze data using SQL to identify trends, opportunities, anomalies, and business issues.  
- Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and recurring reports for business stakeholders.  
- Gather, refine, and document business requirements through JIRA stories, acceptance criteria, and analyst workflows.  
- Translate business needs into structured analysis plans and measurable outputs.  
- Create and maintain semantic definitions, metric logic, business glossary content, and knowledge documentation.  
- Validate data quality and investigate discrepancies across systems, dashboards, and reporting layers.  
- Present analytical findings through clear summaries, visualizations, and actionable recommendations.  
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams to improve reporting clarity and data understanding.  
- Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, well-documented, and aligned with business objectives.  

Requirements  
Must-Have Skills  
- 3+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Analytics, or a related field.  
- Strong SQL skills with experience working with large datasets.  
- Hands-on experience building dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI platforms.  
- Experience documenting requirements using JIRA, user stories, acceptance criteria, or similar methodologies.  
- Strong business acumen with the ability to understand business questions and translate them into analytical solutions.  
- Excellent written communication skills, particularly in documenting semantic definitio .
